name: San Juan Creek
terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

notes: With hot days and cool sea-air evenings, Paso Robles makes Zinfandel known for being soft and round.

blurb.text: One of the easternmost districts inside the Paso Robles AVA, following the San Juan Creek valley at 980 to 1,600 feet. It sits in the rain shadow of the Santa Lucia Coast Range, so it is warmer and more continental than some of the districts to the west.
